scene: Close every workspace window so the welcome window shows. Recent workspaces lists Alpenglow (open /tmp/Alpenglow.echolot once beforehand so it is in the list) and Examples.

Alpenglow, no environment, Requests module. Click the workspace switcher at the foot of the sidebar (Alpenglow, All changes saved) so its menu is open: Recent Workspaces, New Workspace…, Open Workspace…, Workspace Settings…, Show in Finder.
frame: the sidebar with the open menu

scene: Alpenglow, no environment, Requests module, Orders folder open. Click Orders › List orders, ⌘-click Orders › Get order, then Control-click Get order so the multi-selection menu shows: Run 2 Items, Edit 2 Requests…, New Folder with 2 Items, Move 2 Items To, Move 2 Items to Trash….
frame: the sidebar with the context menu

scene: Alpenglow, Catalog folder open. Select Catalog › List products, ⌘-click Catalog › Search and Catalog › Get product, Control-click one and choose Edit 3 Requests…. Stay on the Headers tab (Accept and Accept-Language appear only on List products, so they show as 1 of 3 with Add to All).
Alpenglow. Control-click the Orders folder and choose Folder Settings…. Auth tab: Bearer Token with {{token}}.

Alpenglow, no environment, request page on Catalog › List products. Click the environment menu in the page header so it is open: No Environment, Local, Staging, Production (shield), Manage Environments….
frame: the page header with the open menu

scene: Alpenglow, no environment. Launch with -page environments, select Staging in the list on the left: its name field, the Protected switch (off), and the variables baseURL, wsURL and password (Secret, Not set on this Mac).

Alpenglow, no environment, request page on Catalog › Get product. Choose View › Show Variables (⌥⌘V) so the floating Variables panel shows the Global, Workspace, Local, Staging, Production, Catalog and Request columns, the value in use marked.
frame: the Variables panel and the request page behind it

scene: Alpenglow, no environment. Send Auth › Sign in once so {{token}} has a value in the Keychain. Then open the Environments page (-page environments), select Workspace: the token row has Secret checked and its value field reads Stored in the Keychain, with the green key.
frame: the variables table on the Environments page

scene: Alpenglow, environment Production (choose it in the page header's environment menu). Request page on Catalog › List products, not sent. The Send button reads Send to Production… in red.
frame: the request page's address bar with the Send button and the environment menu

scene: As workspaces-protected-send-button, then click Send to Production…. The sheet Send to Production? shows with the resolved GET address, Cancel as the default button, Send, and the checkbox Don't ask again until I switch environments. Don't send (Production is a pretend .example host).

Alpenglow, no environment. Send Catalog › List products twice, Catalog › Get product, Auth › Sign in and Orders › List orders; run the Catalog folder in the Runner (Run Folder) so Runner rows appear. Then open View › History (⌘Y), Sent by All.
Alpenglow, no environment. Send Catalog › List products five times. Click the clock button with the count in the response pane's strip so the history popover lists the five responses.
frame: the response pane with the open popover

scene: As workspaces-request-history (at least two responses of Catalog › List products). In the popover, rest on the older row and click its compare arrows; the Compare Responses sheet shows on Body. If the two bodies are identical, send Auth › Sign in, then Orders › Create order twice and compare those (each answer has a new order ID).
Echolot › Settings…, Storage pane. Encrypt response bodies on disk off, Keep response bodies up to 5 GB, History per request 50 responses (the defaults).

Alpenglow. File › Export Workspace… (⇧⌘E). The sheet lists the four formats with Postman Collection v2.1 suggested (21 of 29 requests · MCP, MQTT, Socket.IO, WebSocket, and gRPC stay behind); Include environments (3) checked.

As workspaces-export-sheet, Postman Collection v2.1, click Export… and save to /tmp. The report: Exported 21 requests, 7 folders, 3 environments as Postman Collection v2.1 to … with Left out (8 requests) and Changed on the way (captures, $randomInt kept as written, 1 password written in clear).
frame: the Export Workspace sheet showing the report

scene: Alpenglow. Control-click the Orders folder › Folder Settings…, Auth tab: OAuth 2.0, Client Credentials, token URL {{baseURL}}/oauth/token, client ID and secret as variables, scope orders; click Get Token so the token bar shows the token.

tools/scenes.ts: a copy of Alpenglow with a new secret workspace variable webhook_secret. Environments page, Workspace; click its value field and type an ordinary word (never saved: the field is emptied before the app quits).
frame: the Workspace variables card down to the warning
